blockers.detail: Primary-source corroboration is explicitly assigned to Council Alpha; Resolver defers the downstream contradiction symptom until root-owner evidence changes the input signature.

Existing immutable resolver evidence/dispositions already classify the routed contradiction as resolved/non-gating or direct reconciliation to stop the resolver loop. Repeating the same strategy would violate anti-repeat.

learning.changedStrategy: Applied dependency and anti-repeat filtering instead of re-researching unchanged contradiction strings.
learning.repeatedBlocker: Resolver routing still contains contradiction rows whose existing resolver disposition is resolved/non-gating or whose remaining concrete work belongs to Council Alpha.
learning.failedStrategy: Repeatedly re-inspecting the same contradiction without materially changed input.
learning.chiefDecisionNeeded: Reconcile should consume immutable resolver contradiction dispositions so already-resolved rows leave the Resolver queue; dependent Alpha-owned corroboration should not keep Resolver active unless a new independent material contradiction appears.
